title: Single tensor counit factorization under a scheme isomorphism
statement: Let X,P,Z be schemes [def-pc-scheme], p:P→X a morphism and e:Z≅P an isomorphism. Choose the derived categories of sheaves of modules in one universe [def-pc-derived-category] and assume the tensor pullbacks are additive. Write L_s and R_s for derived pullback and direct image [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Write a_s for the adjunction pinned to the selected derived counit [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], c(e,p):L_p⋙L_e≅L_{ep} for the selected composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and χ_s(M):L_s(M[0])→(s^*M)[0] for the pinned single tensor counit [lem-pc-pinned-single-tensor-shifts]. There is a natural isomorphism t from the functor M↦R_e((ep)^*M)[0] to M↦(p^*M)[0] such that for every sheaf of modules M on X, with K=M[0], η_e(L_p K) followed by R_e(c(e,p)_K followed by χ_{ep}(M)) followed by t_M equals χ_p(M). The functor R_e is applied to the whole single complex in the source of t. No flatness, quasi-coherence or nonemptiness is required.

theorem exists_isomorphic_single_tensor_counit
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X P Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ X) (e : Z ≅ P) :
    let c := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})))
    let a := fun {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) ↦
      Classical.choose (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction s
        (hAdd := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) s)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)) s)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) s))
    ∃ t : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (e.hom ≫ p) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0) ⋙
          schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom ≅
        Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings P.toRingedSpace)) 0,
      ∀ M : X.Modules,
        let K := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M
        (a e.hom).unit.app ((derivedPullback p).obj K) ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom).map
              ((c e.hom p).hom.app K ≫ pinnedSingleTensorCounit (e.hom ≫ p) 0 M) ≫
            t.hom.app M = pinnedSingleTensorCounit p 0 M
